_comment: Alias table as DATA, not code branches (§8). Chartix's canonical id is the
NSE ticker in upper case; these are the other spellings the same instrument
arrives as, from Yahoo exports, TradingView, broker statements and other
terminals. Add rows here rather than adding cases to a resolver.
Only non-derivable aliases belong here. NSE:RELIANCE and RELIANCE.NS are
handled by the exchange-qualified and Yahoo-style rules in symbols.ts and

Every target here was resolved against the live universe on 16 Oct 2026. VIX/INDIAVIX -> INDIA_VIX was removed: that symbol is absent from instruments entirely, and /eod answers 200 with zero bars rather than 404, so the alias looked plausible and resolved to nothing. Verify a target before adding it.

renamed._comment: EMPTY ON PURPOSE. §9 wants CHARTIX_SYMBOL_CHANGED with the replacement rather than a short series, and the mechanism is built and tested — but it is fed by verified rows only. MINDTREE/LTI -> LTIM was removed on 16 Oct 2026: LTIM is in Chartix as is_active=0 with 5 bars ending 2024-07-29, and MINDTREE and LTI are absent entirely, so the mapping would have redirected a user to a dead symbol. Chartix has no usable data for that instrument under any spelling, which is a different answer from 'it was renamed'. Add a row only after checking the target is active and has current bars.
